comment: The worked example's sound, as a SPEC — nothing is rendered until someone runs `npm run trailer -- example --go` with a voice key. Until then the timeline plays as a silent draft, which is exactly how you iterate on picture for free. Note the direction in the lines: bracketed tags, ellipses for real pauses, CAPS on the word that carries the sentence. A line handed over as plain text is read flat.

render.text: [warmly] This is a trailer stage. It films your app, narrates it... and cuts itself to the voice.
[curious] Everything you see is a JSON file. A card, a chart, a grid of weights... all of it DATA, that you can edit by hand.
And every beat is anchored to a line of narration. So re-record ONE line... and the whole cut re-times itself.
[confident] Write a brief. Get a trailer.

render.prompt: Minimal, elegant, modern ambient for a product explainer: soft felt piano, warm analog pads, a light steady pulse, unhurried and optimistic, instrumental, no vocals, clean and spacious
